newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian All Ordinaries index hits record high.
newsitem.headline: Australian All Ordinaries index hits record high.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange's benchmark, the All Ordinaries index, climbed 23.1 points to a record high 2,515.8 in morning trade on Tuesday after Wall Street continued to reach fresh highs.
This surpassed the previous record high of 2,515.1, set on April 30. The record closing level remains at 2,501.7, reached on February 18, 1997.
